metas.name: Argentina - Chevrons
metas.note:
• Argentina typically uses white-and-red chevrons.

--- NOTE:

  • Argentina is the only American country with these chevrons.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/argentina for more clues.

metas.name: Australia - Chevrons
metas.note:
• Australia uses white on black chevrons.
  • They also use black on yellow chevrons but are much rarer.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/australia for more clues.

metas.name: Austria - Chevrons
metas.note:
Austria uses two colour schemes for chevrons:

  • White on red
  • Red on yellow

--- NOTE:

  • Germany mostly uses red on white chevrons, and rarely red on yellow.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/austria for more clues.

metas.name: Brazil - Chevrons
metas.note: • Brazil uses yellow on black chevrons, as opposed to most of South America, which use black on yellow chevrons.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/brazil for more clues.

metas.name: France - Chevrons
metas.note:
• France uses chevrons with white arrows on a blue background.
  • They can have a wide amount of arrows, ranging from one to five.

--- NOTE:

  • The only other European country with this colour scheme is Spain, where you will only find chevrons with two or four arrows.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/france for more clues.

metas.name: Greece - Chevrons
metas.note:
• Greek chevrons have white arrows on a black background.

--- NOTE:

  • Similar chevrons are found in Albania, Italy and the UK.
  • Spain has the same colours, but will almost always have either two or four arrows.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/greece for more clues.

metas.name: Ireland - Chevrons
metas.note:
• Irish chevrons are yellow on black.
  • Both single and multiple arrows are common.

--- NOTE:

  • UK chevrons are white on black.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/ireland for more clues.

metas.name: Israel - Chevrons
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/israel-west-bank for more clues.

metas.name: Italy - Chevrons
metas.note:
• Italian chevrons are white arrows on a black background.

--- NOTE:

  • In Southern Europe, white on black chevrons can also be found in Spain, Greece and Albania.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/italy for more clues.

metas.name: Jordan - Chevrons
metas.note:
• Jordanian chevrons are white with red arrows.

--- NOTE:

You can use chevrons to distinguish between Jordan and Israel:

  • The Israeli chevrons are black with white arrows.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/jordan for more clues.

metas.name: Lithuania - Chevrons
metas.note:
• Lithuania uses white chevrons with red arrows.
  • The small single chevrons (pictured here) usually have a red outline on the edge of the sign.

--- NOTE:

  • Many other European countries, including Latvia and Poland, use the same chevrons (though without the red outline).
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/lithuania for more clues.

metas.name: Norway - Chevrons
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/norway for more clues.

metas.name: Portugal - Chevrons
metas.note:
• Portuguese chevrons are black with yellow arrows.

--- NOTE:

  • Portugal is the only Mediterranean country with this chevron colour scheme.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/portugal for more clues.

metas.name: Serbia - Chevrons
metas.note:
• Serbia uses chevrons with a black arrow on a white background.

--- NOTE:

  • Within Europe, these chevrons can also be found in Slovenia, Montenegro and North Macedonia.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/serbia for more clues.

metas.name: South Africa - Chevrons
metas.note:
• South Africa uses white-and-red chevrons.
  • In addition, unique-looking small, thin chevrons with one arrow are common next to roads.

--- NOTE:

  • The thin chevrons can also be found in the other southern African countries of Botswana, Eswatini, and Lesotho.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/south-africa for more clues.

metas.name: Spain - Chevrons
metas.note:
Spain has two chevrons:

  • Black with white arrows.
  • Blue with white arrows.
  • Chevrons with a single arrow are rare.

--- NOTE:

  • In Southern Europe, black with white chevrons can be found in Italy, Greece and Albania.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/spain for more clues.

metas.name: Sweden - Chevrons
metas.note:
• Sweden is the only country in Europe whose chevrons have yellow arrows on a blue background.

--- NOTE:

  • While very rare, yellow on blue chevrons also exist in Luxembourg.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/sweden for more clues.

metas.name: United Kingdom - Chevrons
metas.note:
• Chevrons are black with white arrows.

--- NOTE:

  • Irish chevrons are black with yellow arrows.
  • French chevrons are blue with white arrows.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-kingdom for more clues.
